mapper.sql: id, email, email_normalized, password_hash, status, session_version, created_at, updated_at, verified_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user WHERE email_normalized = #{emailNormalized} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM app_user WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, email, email_normalized, password_hash, status, session_version, created_at, updated_at, verified_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{emailNormalized}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{sessionVersion}, 0), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{verifiedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, session_version = session_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE app_user SET status = 'DISABLED', session_version = session_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'DISABLED' AND status != 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
